status: Reviewed compatibility supplement for Claude; this is not permission to alter human-curated taxonomy or tags.
consumerRule: Keep existing Type definitions and human-curated assignments. Treat these broader Scout Types as proposals; do not delete old Types or automatically retag human records. These are service-navigation changes, not resource identity merges.

retainedIdentityCorrections.reason: Housing legal advice and representation retain the previously delivered Type identity. The new wording does not justify a new ID.

previousType.label: Infant Formula
previousType.definition: An explicitly documented route to infant formula; not inferred from general food boxes.

proposedType.label: Infant and young-child nutrition
proposedType.definition: WIC and targeted infant/young-child food or formula assistance.

broaderReplacements.reason: Broader infant/young-child nutrition includes WIC and food as well as explicitly documented formula. Original formula-specific facts remain searchable; a broader label alone does not promise formula.

previousType.label: Affordable Housing
previousType.definition: Below-market rental housing with program-specific income and availability rules.

proposedType.label: Affordable rentals
proposedType.definition: Income-restricted apartments, vouchers and rental application/waitlist programmes.

broaderReplacements.reason: Combines below-market rental properties with voucher and waitlist routes; resource-specific eligibility and application status distinguish them.

previousType.label: Housing Vouchers
previousType.definition: Rental subsidy or housing voucher application and administration.

proposedType.label: Affordable rentals
proposedType.definition: Income-restricted apartments, vouchers and rental application/waitlist programmes.

broaderReplacements.reason: Voucher programmes now share a rental-access Type with income-restricted properties. Do not infer that an apartment listing administers vouchers.

previousType.label: Treatment Housing
previousType.definition: Residential housing available as part of a clinical treatment program with admission and payer requirements.

proposedType.label: Recovery housing
proposedType.definition: Sober living or residential recovery programmes; treatment and house requirements are stated separately.

broaderReplacements.reason: Broader recovery housing includes sober living as well as residential treatment; clinical admission and payer rules remain programme-specific.

previousType.label: Rapid Rehousing
previousType.definition: Time-limited assistance to move from homelessness into housing with stabilization support.

proposedType.label: Rent and deposit help
proposedType.definition: Rental subsidies, homelessness prevention, rapid rehousing or move-in/deposit assistance with programme-specific eligibility.

broaderReplacements.reason: Broader rent/deposit assistance includes rapid rehousing, prevention and subsidies. Homelessness and coordinated-entry requirements remain in the individual programme.

previousType.label: Fares and Passes
previousType.definition: Bus passes, reduced fares or ride vouchers; mode, eligibility and available funding remain in the service details.

proposedType.label: Fares and fuel
proposedType.definition: Passes, fare reductions, fuel grants and medical-travel reimbursement.

broaderReplacements.reason: Expanded to fuel grants and medical-travel reimbursement as well as fares, passes and ride vouchers.

previousType.label: Travel Training
previousType.definition: Instruction and practical support learning to use transportation independently.

proposedType.label: Planning and travel skills
proposedType.definition: Help finding ride options, planning trips or learning to use transit.

broaderReplacements.reason: Expanded to route planning and ride navigation as well as practical independent-travel training.

previousType.label: ADA Paratransit
previousType.definition: Accessible paratransit requiring its specific eligibility assessment and reservation process.

proposedType.label: Accessible rides
proposedType.definition: Disability-related paratransit and accessible on-demand ride options.

broaderReplacements.reason: Expanded to non-ADA accessible ride services. ADA eligibility and reservations remain explicit in actual paratransit records; the broad Type alone does not establish ADA service.

previousType.label: Immigration Documents
previousType.definition: Replacement or correction of immigration-related identity/status documents, or qualified legal help obtaining them.

proposedType.label: Immigration and consular documents
proposedType.definition: Immigration, citizenship, passport, tax-identification or foreign-consular documents and their supporting procedures.

broaderReplacements.reason: Expanded to citizenship, passports, consular and tax-identification documents; legal authority and assistance scope remain resource-specific.

previousType.label: Birth Certificates
previousType.definition: Issuance or specifically documented assistance obtaining a birth certificate.

proposedType.label: Birth and civil records
proposedType.definition: Birth, death, marriage and other certified civil records, including help obtaining them.

broaderReplacements.reason: Expanded from specifically documented birth certificates to other certified civil records as well.

previousType.label: Document Storage
previousType.definition: A specifically documented service keeping important documents safe.

proposedType.label: Mail and document storage
proposedType.definition: A reliable mailing address or secure storage for important identity documents.

broaderReplacements.reason: Combines secure document storage with reliable mailing-address services; a mail-only resource must not be described as storing documents.

previousType.label: Mail Service
previousType.definition: A mailing or document-receipt service for people who need a reliable address.

proposedType.label: Mail and document storage
proposedType.definition: A reliable mailing address or secure storage for important identity documents.

broaderReplacements.reason: Combines reliable mailing-address service with document storage; specific records distinguish which is actually offered.

previousType.label: Military Records
previousType.definition: Obtaining, recording or replacing military service/discharge records.

proposedType.label: Supporting records
proposedType.definition: Education, military, benefit and occupational records used to establish a history, credential or eligibility; these are not necessarily accepted photo identification.

broaderReplacements.reason: Expanded beyond military records to educational, benefit and occupational records. Actual DD214 pathways and fees remain in prepared text.
